label: v101
changes: Passport scans are now reliably filed to ID & Passports, even when photographed as multiple pages
A warning banner appears if a passport-looking scan didn't get a full passport record — so nothing slips through silently
New: duplicate-document detection — scanning or uploading a file that looks already saved now asks Replace existing or Keep both, instead of silently creating a copy
Applies everywhere you add a document: AI chat, a member's own Documents tab, and the shared Document Vault
